opening.argument: The speaker promotes placing money in a shared Bitcoin trading pool while claiming members receive a 12% monthly average. He pairs that investment pitch with invitations to join his team and promote an affiliate link, making recruitment part of the opportunity he offers. He describes percentage payments for bringing people onto a team and claims a $1,600 commission tied to another participant's Bitcoin contribution after a seven-day wait. These are concrete earnings claims used to encourage investment and recruitment. Together, the pooled investment pitch, recruitment requests, and claimed commission support finding a recruitment-commission scam. The opportunity is presented as the speaker's own, but the investment and earnings claims are not independently confirmed; the evidence does not establish actual losses or realized returns.
